tasks.label: shojiwm: install (dev)
tasks.detail: dist/install.sh --dev --no-config, the RustRover install action. Builds release-fast, then asks for sudo. Takes effect at the next session start. Runs in a memory-bounded transient scope (see 'build limits' below).

tasks.label: xwayland-satellite: build release
tasks.detail: The compositor spawns target/release/xwayland-satellite via SHOJI_XWAYLAND_SATELLITE_PATH, so the build is the install. Takes effect at the next session start.

tasks.label: minkafx: build release
tasks.detail: MINKA_FX_BIN points at target/release/MinkaFX. Restart MinkaFX (or the session) to pick it up.

tasks.label: minkacap: build release
tasks.detail: MINKA_CAP_BIN points at target/release/MinkaCap. MinkaShot runs it per capture, so the next capture uses it.

tasks.label: minkaledger: build core release
tasks.detail: The launcher runs target/release/minka-ledger. Restart MinkaLedger afterwards: the running core keeps the old inode.

tasks.label: bartizan-lsp: build release
tasks.detail: The editor launches target/release/bartizan-lsp directly. Restart the LSP afterwards.

tasks.label: build limits (reference, does nothing)
tasks.detail: Every build task above runs as `systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryHigh=6G -p MemoryMax=10G` with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6. MemoryHigh throttles by reclaim (the build slows, it does not die); MemoryMax is the backstop and DOES kill inside the scope, so a build that dies with a bare 'signal: 9, SIGKILL' hit 10G — raise it here, do not raise it globally. 6 of 8 jobs leaves the desktop two cores and cuts peak RSS, which scales with concurrent rustc. Rationale: 6/9/2026, a release-fast build on top of an 8G lspmux/rust-analyzer set off a four-minute kernel OOM storm (13 kills, none of them the build) that took out Code, GitKraken and the portals. Bounding the build keeps the kill inside the build's own cgroup.
tasks.command: echo 'Reference task — see the detail field. Nothing to run.'

tasks.label: session: rebuild everything the next session runs
tasks.detail: Satellite, MinkaFX and MinkaCap release builds, then the ShojiWM install (sudo prompt comes last). Sequential, so only one bounded scope is live at a time.
